sources.snippet: The chart above evaluates user preference for SDXL (with and without refinement) over Stable Diffusion 1.5 and 2.1. The SDXL base model performs significantly better than the previous variants, and the model combined with the refinement module achieves the best overall performance.

sources.title: SDXL AI Models & Generator | Civitai
sources.snippet: SDXL is a larger, later Stability AI model that renders natively at 1024px with better composition and prompt understanding than SD 1.5. Try both on Civitai and compare.
